overloadMerges.note: blob is mutated in place (shrunk by len bytes), so marked inout; the draft's param name 'blob' was actually taken from the table's 'Blob' header row, kept as-is for readability.

params.name: blob
params.description: BLOB to shrink in place; becomes len bytes smaller.

constraints: Because it alters the BLOB parameter in place, this command does not support 4D.Blob objects, only legacy BLOB variables/fields (see Passing blobs and blob objects to 4D commands).
